messages:
nick_procurement: Heads up — BlueFreight just replied on the H200 top-off. They can split the shipment: 40 units by air (expedite) + 60 by sea (economy). Air ETA 3 days, sea ETA 18 days. They propose we file the RMA now for the 40 and leave the rest as 'pending replacement'. Need a call on customs/HS classification and whether we absorb expedite fee or take credit memo later.

sara_ops: Quick Q — are the 40 air units all serial-matched to our order pool? last time we had a partial-serial mismatch and it created staging chaos.

julia_logistics: I asked BlueFreight to confirm serial batches. Vendor rep replied with AWBs and batch ranges. Posting the snippet they sent:
```
AWB: BF1234567890 - Ser range: S1001-S1040 - Air - 40 units
AWB: BF-SEA-998877 - Ser range: S1041-S1100 - Sea - 60 units
```

mike_dock: If air arrives first we need a fast depot window for acceptance. Dock has 2 slots/day; priority slot costs $450/slot for OOH. If we route through our preferred 3PL (BlueGate) we keep standard slots but they charge handling fee + inspection.

vendor_rep_bluefreight: Apologies for the delay — confirmed serial ranges above. Air shipment can be upgraded to 'white-glove' for an extra $5k which includes expedited customs brokerage and unload priority. Sea is locked at current manifest; we can re-route to FRA or AMS but that adds 2-4 days.

chris_finance: We need an estimate on per-unit landed cost delta for air vs sea including duty, brokerage, and depot OOH. If expedite saves outage days (we're projecting ~30% cluster throttle cost during shortage) that might justify the $5k. Can ops provide outage risk number?

sara_ops: Cluster health team says we can stagger preemptible allocations for the first 30 units, but once we hit 70% utilization across edge pools we'll start throttling inference jobs. Estimated business impact = ~$12k/day once throttled.

julia_logistics: Customs note — bluefreight suggests HS reclass to speed clearance; that needs brokerage sign-off. If we misclassify we risk penalties. I recommend we accept the air shipment but push for vendor to cover half of the white-glove fee and a partial credit memo if sea manifests a serial mismatch.

nick_procurement: Proposal: accept the air 40 now, bill-share the $5k (vendor pays $2.5k), book one OOH slot ($450) and route to BlueGate for consolidated inspection. For the sea 60, require pre-shipment manifest verification and vendor to cover any reconsignment fees if serials mismatch. @vendor_rep_bluefreight can you confirm vendor acceptance?

vendor_rep_bluefreight: We can accept the cost-share on white-glove and will absorb reconsignment fees for sea-side serial mismatches up to 5 units per 100. We'll provide final manifest within 24 hours.

mike_dock: Ok from dock — reserve one OOH slot provisional. Send final AWB to dispatch_bot to generate pickup docs.

dispatch_bot: Pickup docs created: DCDOC-531234-01. Please confirm AWB to attach.

julia_logistics: Attaching final AWB for air to dispatch_bot: BF1234567890. Also tagging @chris_finance for invoice split (vendor pays $2.5k, we invoice $2.5k).

chris_finance: Logged. I'll create a purchase adjustment and route PO amendment once we get the manifest. Please escalate if vendor misses 24h manifest SLA.

nick_procurement: Thanks everyone — action items: vendor to send final manifest (24h), finance to prep PO amendment, dock to hold slot pending docs, ops to prepare staging with serial intake checklist. Reopen if vendor misses commitments. :thumbsup:
